benchmark_sp24_forward_pass: run the sp24 forward-pass benchmark with MLP models using xformers sparsify24 on various batch and feature sizes
benchmark_sp24_forward_backward: run the sp24 forward-and-backward benchmark with MLP models using xformers sparsify24 on various batch and feature sizes
create_MlpAct24: create an MlpAct24 module that applies xops.sparsify24 to activations in a two-layer MLP with GELU
create_MlpW24: create an MlpW24 module that sparsifies weights with xops.sparsify24 using cusparselt backend and 24dense gradient
test_MicrobenchmarkSparsify24: test the MicrobenchmarkSparsify24 microbenchmark that measures xops.sparsify24 sparsity pattern creation latency
